selection: Only one of twelve complete native trials failed; selected without paired outcomes
native_failure: Second press at transition 520 to 521; release by 530; new request at 530; third press before other block reaches center at 532

branches.name: unchanged
branches.purpose: Exact original continuation must reproduce before any image intervention

branches.name: second_press_witness
branches.purpose: Evaluator-selected legal image immediately after the second press; diagnostic only

branches.name: public_recency
branches.purpose: Latest strictly past observed frame; no evaluator labels used by this rule

intervention_semantics: Content-only diagnostic. Original event timestamp 180, confidence, slot and all first-request anchors are fixed. Actual replacement pixel provenance is separately audited as 521 or 529. This does not validate an authentic-timestamp retrieval implementation.
oracle_scope: One candidate stage witness, not an exhaustive best-evidence oracle or certified upper bound
baseline_scope: Recency is a simple reference, not a claim that all strongest public baselines were evaluated
interpretation: Negative probes cannot prove no historical evidence could ever help. Stop this bounded task route if no interpretable control repair supports the hypothesized memory-selection problem.
numerical_settings: Same checkpoint, BF16, SDPA, image resolution, rendering, step limits, natural parent and request-index RNG as native census
cooling: scripts/pace_evidence_census.py; wall-clock pauses only; one GPU worker at a time
